test_scenarios.description: Verify that fabricated trace IDs, metric names, and topology nodes cannot be validated through prefix matching shortcuts.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Validator must reject all ungrounded IDs as MISSING_OR_UNRESOLVED despite matching prefix patterns.
test_scenarios.actual_result: All three fabricated citations classified as MISSING_OR_UNRESOLVED.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that valid telemetry from completed Incident B is rejected when cited in active Incident A.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Telemetry from non-active incidents must be rejected or segregated as CROSS_INCIDENT.
test_scenarios.actual_result: Citation classified as CROSS_INCIDENT with message 'does not match active incident'.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that historical postmortems or incident IDs cannot be presented as current direct telemetry.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Historical evidence cannot masquerade as real-time incident telemetry.
test_scenarios.actual_result: Both source_id and metadata historical representations classified as CROSS_INCIDENT.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that evidence outside the active incident observation window is classified as STALE.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Expired or out-of-window signals must be rejected with STALE classification.
test_scenarios.actual_result: Citation classified as STALE with expiration explanation.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that deployment events with null or unparseable timestamps do not crash CandidateScorer or DeploymentEvidenceEvaluator.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Evaluator must degrade gracefully, return neutral/inconclusive score (0.20), and prevent scoring crashes.
test_scenarios.actual_result: Scorer executed cleanly without exception; deployment score evaluated to 0.20 with missing timestamp flag.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that service restarts and high error rates without memory saturation do not falsely generate OOM root cause candidates.

signals.message: Worker pod restarted due to unhandled NullPointerException

test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Absence of memory limit saturation prevents false OOM candidate generation.
test_scenarios.actual_result: No OOM or Memory Exhaustion candidate was generated. Crash attributed to software exception.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that a routine deployment preceding an explicit DNS resolution failure does not dominate the root cause ranking.

adversarial_payload.deployment_message: Routine deployment of static asset bundle v1.0.12

test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Explicit infrastructure failure (DNS) ranks higher than an unrelated prior deployment.
test_scenarios.actual_result: DNS candidate scored highest and led RCA ranking.

test_scenarios.description: Verify server-side fail-closed authorization across missing org, malformed org, unauthorized org, cross-tenant repair, and cross-tenant feedback.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: All 5 attack vectors must fail closed (403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found).
test_scenarios.actual_result: 1: 403 Forbidden (Missing org); 2: 403 Forbidden (Malformed org); 3: 403 Forbidden (Not authorized); 4: 403 Forbidden (Cross-tenant repair); 5: 404/403 (Cross-tenant feedback).

test_scenarios.description: Verify that conflicting low-signal telemetry results in safe abstention or low-confidence fallback rather than confident false diagnosis.
test_scenarios.expected_security_invariant: Hypothesis confidence must remain low and abstain from claiming critical infrastructure failure.
test_scenarios.actual_result: Confidence score capped conservatively; no speculative critical failure diagnosed.
